title: Piyaas achi hai chacha
body:
Piyaas achi hai chacha
(Aap ache hai cha cha) x2
per ye zamaana nahi acha
Piyaas achi hai magar, Aap ka jaana nahi acha (x3)
<<MINI>>
Aap ache hai..
<<DIVIDER>>
Asaman royenga khaymo me kayamat hogi (x2)
Din alam Daye alam khaymo me lana nahi acha
<<MINI>>
Aap ache hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Sirf ek raat me kyu bura huwa hai sajaad (x2)
Sar khule mawo ke beto ko dikhana nahi acha
<<MINI>>
Aap ache hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek shehzadi thi jis shehre ki bibi zainab (x2)
Iske bazaaro me zainab ko phiraana nahi acha
<<MINI>>
Aap ache hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jese zindan me sakina hai mili baba se (x2)
Istarha baap se beti ko milana nahi acha
Khush nassebi hai jo de bap ko beta kandhaa (x2)
Bap ka lashe jawaa haye uthana nahi acha
<<MINI>>
Aap ache hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kabr asger ki banaa kar hai bari shaan hussain (x2)
Aag si reth me ek phool chupaana nahi acha
<<MINI>>
Aap ache hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab hame shaa me rahugi isi zindan me cha cha(x2)
Me na kehti thi muje chor ke jaana nahi acha
<<MINI>>
Aap ache hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar khule bibiya roti hai azakhano me(x2)
Shabe ashur charago ko jalaana nahi acha
<<MINI>>
Aap ache hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Har khushi sadke me zainab ke khuda de tujko (x2)
Ha muharram me khushi koi manaana nahi acha
<<MINI>>
Aap ache hai..
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ali waalon ko ay sarwar-o-rehaan kabhi
farshe matam ke siwa dhoondne jaana nahi acha
aap achay hai chacha……
